papers.title: Multi-Laser Powder Bed Fusion Benchmarking—Initial Trials with Inconel 625
papers.abstract: Abstract Production rate is an increasingly important factor in the deployment of metal additive manufacturing (AM) throughout industry. To address the perceived low production rate of metal AM systems based on single-laser powder bed fusion (L-PBF), several companies now offer systems in which melting has been parallelised by the introduction of multiple, independently controlled laser beams. Nevertheless, a full set of studies is yet to be conducted to benchmark the efficiency of multi-laser systems and, at the same time, to verify if the mechanical properties of components are compromised due to the increase in build rate. This study addresses the described technology gaps and presents a 4-beam L-PBF system operating in “single multi” (SM) mode (SM-L-PBF) where each of the four lasers is controlled so that it melts all of a particular components’ layers and produces specimens for comparison with standard L-PBF specimens from the same machine. That is all four lasers making all of some of the parts were compared to a single-laser manufacturing all of the parts. Build parameters were kept constant throughout the manufacturing process and the material used was Inconel 625 (IN625). Stress-relieving heat treatment was conducted on As-built (AB) specimens. Both AB and heat-treated (HT) specimen sets were tested for density, microstructure, tensile strength and hardness. Results indicate that the stress-relieving heat treatment increases specimen ductility without compromising other mechanical properties. SM-L-PBF has achieved a build rate of 14 cm 3 /h when four 200 W lasers were used to process IN625 at a layer thickness of 30 μm. An increase in the build rate of 2.74 times (build time reduction: 63%) has been demonstrated when compared to that of L-PBF, with little to no compromises in specimen mechanical properties. The observed tensile properties exceed the American Society for Testing Materials (ASTM) requirements for IN625 (by a margin of 22 to 26% in the 0.2% offset yield strength). Average specimen hardness and grain size are in the same order as that reported in literatures. The study has demonstrated that a multi-laser AM system opens up opportunities to tackle the impasse of low build rate in L-PBF in an industrial setting and that at least when operating in single mode there is no detectable degradation in the mechanical and crystallographic characteristics of the components produced.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究多激光粉末床熔融的工艺参数与力学性能，但所用材料为Inconel 625，非生物医用材料，且未涉及多孔结构或应力屏蔽等生物力学问题。
llm.why_not_core: The paper does not cover biomedical implants, porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue testing, surface roughness, or osseointegration; it focuses on multi-laser PBF process benchmarking with Inconel 625.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高金属增材制造的生产率并验证多激光系统的力学性能。
summary_zh.method: 使用四激光粉末床熔融系统制造IN625试样，对比单激光与多激光模式。
summary_zh.result: 多激光模式使建造速率提升2.74倍，且力学性能未降低。
summary_zh.validation: 通过密度、显微组织、拉伸和硬度测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: To benchmark multi-laser powder bed fusion efficiency and verify that mechanical properties are not compromised by increased build rate.
summary_en.method: Specimens of IN625 were fabricated using a four-laser PBF system in single multi mode and compared with single-laser mode; both as-built and stress-relieved conditions were tested.
summary_en.result: Multi-laser PBF achieved a 2.74× build rate increase without degrading tensile strength, ductility, or hardness relative to single-laser PBF.
summary_en.validation: Density, microstructure, tensile, and hardness tests were conducted on as-built and heat-treated specimens.

papers.title: Cell encapsulation in gelatin bioink impairs 3D bioprinting resolution
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Rowan University, 201 Mullica Hill Rd., Glassboro, NJ, 08028, USA

corresponding_authors.name: Amir K. Miri
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Rowan University, 201 Mullica Hill Rd., Glassboro, NJ, 08028, USA. Electronic address: miri@rowan.edu

papers.venue: Journal of the mechanical behavior of biomedical materials/Journal of mechanical behavior of biomedical materials

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文探讨明胶生物墨水中细胞封装对3D生物打印分辨率的影响，未涉及人工智能方法。
llm.why_not_core: No AI/ML integration in any bioprinting stage; purely experimental study on bioink properties.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究细胞封装对明胶生物墨水打印分辨率的影响。
summary_zh.method: 通过实验测量不同细胞密度下打印线条的宽度变化。
summary_zh.result: 细胞封装显著降低打印分辨率，细胞密度越高分辨率越低。
summary_zh.validation: 基于光学显微镜测量的实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate how cell encapsulation in gelatin bioink affects the resolution of 3D bioprinted constructs.
summary_en.method: Experimental measurement of printed line width at varying cell densities using optical microscopy.
summary_en.result: Cell encapsulation impairs printing resolution, with higher cell densities leading to greater line widening.
summary_en.validation: In vitro experimental validation via microscopic imaging of printed lines.

corresponding_authors.name: Xianwei Zhou
corresponding_authors.affiliation: State Key Laboratory for Advanced Metals and Materials, University of Science and Technology Beijing, Beijing 100083, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了选择性激光熔化不锈钢的后热处理工艺，虽不直接针对生物医学植入物，但材料力学性能优化方法对植入物制造有参考价值。
llm.why_not_core: No porous structure for stress shielding, no fatigue testing, no surface roughness or osseointegration evaluation, and no direct biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究热处理对选区激光熔化沉淀硬化不锈钢微观组织和力学性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 采用选区激光熔化和不同热处理工艺制备试样，并进行微观表征和力学测试。
summary_zh.result: 获得了细化的微观组织和优异的综合力学性能。
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸、硬度等力学实验和显微组织观察验证。

summary_en.motivation: This study aims to investigate the influence of heat treatment on the microstructure and mechanical properties of precipitation hardening stainless steel fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Specimens were prepared via selective laser melting followed by various heat treatments, and characterized through microstructural analysis and mechanical testing.
summary_en.result: Refined microstructure and excellent combination of strength and ductility were achieved.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through tensile and hardness tests along with microstructural observation.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究选区激光熔化过程中的扫描间距优化，未涉及生物医学植入物或骨整合性能。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address biomedical implant design, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration; it focuses solely on SLM process parameter optimization for general metal parts.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化双扫描SLM中的扫描间距以提高致密度和表面质量。
summary_zh.method: 建立有限体积法模型模拟温度场和流场，并通过实验验证。
summary_zh.result: 获得了最优扫描间距，改善了熔道重叠和表面形貌。
summary_zh.validation: 通过致密度和表面粗糙度测量验证模型预测。

summary_en.motivation: To optimize hatch space in double-scanning selective laser melting for improved part density and surface quality.
summary_en.method: A finite volume method model was developed to simulate temperature and velocity fields during double-scanning, validated with experiments.
summary_en.result: An optimal hatch space was identified that enhances melt track overlap and surface morphology.
summary_en.validation: Experimental measurements of density and surface roughness validated the model predictions.

papers.title: Tensile and Creep Properties Improvement of Ti-6Al-4V Alloy Specimens Produced by Electron Beam Powder Bed Fusion Additive Manufacturing
papers.abstract: Thanks to their excellent mechanical strength in combination with low density, high melting point, and good resistance to corrosion, titanium alloys are very useful in many industrial and biomedical fields. The new additive manufacturing methods, such as Electron Beam Powder Bed Fusion based on the deposition of metal powders layers progressively molten by electron beam scanning, can overcome many of the machining problems concerning the production of peculiar shapes made of Ti alloys. However, the processing route is strictly determinant for mechanical performance of products, especially in the case of Ti alloys. In the present work flat specimens made of Ti-6Al-4V alloy produced by Electron Beam Powder Bed Fusion (or Electron Beam Melting) have been built and post-processed with the purpose of obtaining good tensile and creep performance. Preliminarily, the process parameters were set according to literature evidence and machine producer recommendations, validated by the results of a thermal analysis, aimed at satisfying the best processing conditions to reduce defects, as unmelted regions, microstructure coarsening or porosity, that are detrimental to mechanical behavior. Subsequently, Hot Isostatic Pressing and surface smoothing were considered, respectively, in order to reduce any internal porosity and lower roughness. Microstructure of the investigated specimens was characterized by optical and scanning electron microscopy observations and by X-ray diffraction measurements. Results show enhanced tensile behavior after the hot pressing treatment that allows to relieve stresses and reduce defects detrimental to mechanical properties. The best ductility was obtained by the combined effects of machining and densification. Creep test results verify the beneficial effects of surface smoothing.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及Ti-6Al-4V的电子束粉末床熔融增材制造及力学性能测试，但未讨论多孔结构或应力遮挡，与生物医学植入物方向关联较弱。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures for stress shielding, does not use LPBF (uses EBM), does not include fatigue testing, and does not quantify surface roughness or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 改善电子束熔化Ti-6Al-4V合金的拉伸和蠕变性能。
summary_zh.method: 通过热等静压和表面光滑处理优化工艺参数并减少缺陷。
summary_zh.result: 热等静压提高了延展性，表面光滑改善了蠕变性能。
summary_zh.validation: 光学/扫描电镜、X射线衍射及拉伸/蠕变测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: To enhance tensile and creep properties of Ti-6Al-4V alloy produced by electron beam powder bed fusion by optimizing post-processing.
summary_en.method: Hot isostatic pressing and surface smoothing were applied to reduce porosity and roughness, with process parameters validated by thermal analysis.
summary_en.result: Hot isostatic pressing improved ductility, while surface smoothing enhanced creep resistance.
summary_en.validation: Microstructural characterization via SEM, XRD, and mechanical testing (tensile and creep).
